display_name: 时频恢复器源域响应梯度投影单步诊断
description: 同一源波形批次上比较波形目标、固定响应联合目标与梯度冲突投影，检查实际 AdamW 更新及独立源样本损失。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 CPU, two threads, CUDA hidden; source-only fixed evaluation

data.version: 64 previously explored source pilot records, 16 per each of four fixed RX/view groups
data.representation: paired source IQ and one synthetic 1% RMS amplitude-cubic perturbation through DURA estimated action
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: Each of four groups first 8 fit and next 8 heldout; 64 unique records, disjoint from direct fit

roles.L_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth not read
roles.U_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth hidden

data.validation_ref: Frozen DURA real-source smoke and finite source waveform metrics
data.leo_config_ref: fixed source epoch19 seven simulated views

permissions.claim_scope: Single in-memory CPU AdamW step on output heads only; no trained model, identity or target performance claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh CrossExpertRefiner initialized with 2026110830; frozen DURA and direct source final20
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Direct source final20 fit disjoint from fixed source pilot; no in-flight training state loaded
checkpoint.selection_rule: Two fixed rates and three modes (wave-only, unprojected joint, projected joint), independent identical initializations, one step each; no checkpoint saved

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two threads, CUDA hidden; preserve all existing jobs
execution.launch_command: nice -n 15 env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261108-phase1-cross-expert-source-response-projection-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/pamf_stage2_inference_20261021_r01:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u -m experiments.phase1_dura_orthogonal.source_cross_expert_response_projection --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261108-phase1-cross-expert-source-response-projection-s2026092701-r01 --commit d452377d30b04fd938ef7a38645a492d0a01e237
execution.stop_rule: Stop on provenance mismatch, nonfinite values, real-source smoke mismatch, output collision or technical failure

metric_names: wave gradient dot actual AdamW parameter update
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: source clean IQ only, no TX truth

rows.method: wave versus unprojected and projected response gradient
rows.purpose: Check source waveform/response tradeoff after actual one-step AdamW updates
rows.seed_notes: Fresh model initialization uses in-flight model seed 2026110830; no in-flight checkpoint is read.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, head parameters only, weight decay .001
rows.budget_ref: 32 fit plus 32 disjoint heldout records, six independent one-step conditions, CPU 2 threads, no saved weights

notes: Exploratory source-only gradient-conflict follow-up, never target-tuned.
Fixed 32 fit plus 32 heldout explored source records; direct parent fit disjoint; DURA overlap unknown.
Two rates, three independently initialized modes and one head-only AdamW step each; no trained weights saved.
Finite AdamW updates need not preserve the first-order projected-gradient guarantee.
Two focused tests and one independent P0/P1 review passed; real-source checkpoint smoke runs before trials.
No TX labels, F, V or target access; not identity accuracy, full training or formal seven-view evidence.
